'''Rodney''' (Japanese: '''ユキヤ''' ''Yukiya'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW134|The Journalist from Another Region!]].''

Rodney was first seen when {{Ash}} was running to a food stand. Both Trainers bumped into each other, and Rodney mocked Ash with his belief that he would win the [[Pokémon Sumo Tournament]]. This caused a rivalry between the two {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. During the tournament, Rodney went up against {{MTR}}, who was disguised as a {{p|Golem}}. Rodney was not fooled by the disguise, however, and easily defeated {{TRT}}, sending them blasting off in the process. Afterwards, Rodney managed to get through the tournament and made it to the final round, where he faced off against Ash. He lost after {{AP|Pignite}} defeated his {{p|Golurk}}. Even though Ash won, Rodney was given a split apple from Ash, similar to what a {{p|Beartic}} and an {{p|Ursaring}} of Harvest Island folklore had done.
